title: Sule Pagoda
scope: Sule Pagoda at the center of Yangon, with the 46-metre gilded octagonal stupa, four cardinal worship halls and perimeter buildings within the named precinct.
limitations: The model represents the standing precinct following its 2023 regilding. Historic photographs establish the central stupa proportions while the present outer buildings follow their mapped plans.
The tier proportions, doorway height, roof ornament, finial details and modern storefront divisions are estimates.
The immediate court is included. Streets, overhead crossings, neighboring buildings, freestanding interior shrines and signs are outside the model scope.
